title: Moments at the hard edge and Rayleigh functions
summary: Motivated by the analogy between spectral moments of random matrices and associated zeta functions, we study inverse power trace moments of the Laguerre ensemble of dimension $N$ and inverse temperature parameter $β>0$. We consider a large $N$ regime determined by the low-lying eigenvalues of the ensemble known as the hard edge. In the classical cases $β\in \{1,2,4\}$, we obtain explicit results for the inverse moments and extend these to formulae for the corresponding Mellin transforms.
